Summarize intermediate filtering steps by feature

Source: R/vtamR_fun.R
summarize_by.Rd

Summarize the outputs of intermediate filtering steps across all files in a directory. By default, input filenames must start by a number (e.g. 5_filter_occurrence_sample.csv). See pattern to change this behavior.

Usage

summarize_by(
  dir,
  pattern = "^\\d",
  feature,
  grouped_by,
  outfile = NULL,
  sep = ","
)

Arguments

dir

Character string specifying the directory containing intermediate filtering output files. Files must start with a numeric prefix followed by an underscore (e.g. 5_filter_occurrence_sample.csv).

pattern

A regular expression used to select filenames to be scanned.

feature

Character string specifying the feature to summarize. Must be one of "asv_id", "asv", "sample", "replicate", or "read_count".

grouped_by

Character string specifying the grouping variable. Must be one of "asv_id", "asv", "sample", or "replicate".

outfile

Character string specifying the output CSV file name. If NULL, no file is written.

sep

Field separator character used in input and output CSV files.

Value

An invisible data frame where columns correspond to input files, rows correspond to grouped_by values, and cell values represent either counts of feature occurrences or summed read counts.

Details

For each file, rows are grouped by grouped_by, and either:

  • the number of distinct values of feature is computed, or

  • if feature = "read_count", the total read counts are summed per group.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
summarize_by(dir = "vtamR_test/out_mfzr", feature = "asv", grouped_by = "sample")
summarize_by(dir = "vtamR_test/out_mfzr", feature = "read_count", grouped_by = "sample")
} # }
